args.role: Turn a current official UK procurement lot for standalone offline data reconciliation into a tested work sample and a private operator quote. Verify the original notice, supplier conditions and submission route. Track proposal, submission, acceptance and settlement separately.

description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available, but five unclassified sources leave demand and attribution unknown. The latest WordPress brief invited a full site build. That brief does not support a standalone QA quote, and a current brief expressly inviting one would reopen that route. Independently, I’m testing whether a current UK procurement notice supports a separately priced offline data reconciliation job. A qualifying notice will drive a tested sample and private operator proposal. Submission requires existing operator authority, and any public deployment requires host-enforced independent review.
